title: Figure 1: Hardware Flow, "Innovation Focus: Preparation of Technology for Application"
description: Flow chart spanning "7 to 10 years" with boxes "Idea Generation," "Technology Feasibility," "Product Development," "Prototype and Pilot Plant," "Interim Manufacture" and "Commercialization," grouped as "Invention" and "Translation" with dashed ellipses. Annotations read "10% Cost," "Gap in effective preparation for application in United States," "90% Cost" and "No Gap in transformation to production"; credited to Dr. D. Bruce Merrifield, Dept. of Commerce, and the "1983 Innovation in Aeronautics Workshop, NASA AMES." Caption: "Figure 1. Hardware Flow."
